preserved_prerequisite.theoretical_result: At silent equilibrium syn*=0 => dI_rec/domega=0 => b_HW=0; HDP feedback linearly dormant at rest.

scientific_question: Is the HDP closed loop locally stable around an active recurrent operating state?
independent_variable: I_tonic (symmetric tonic drive on A and B)
frozen_hdp_parameters: W3NominalParameters from W3 stability receipt; do not tune kappa_H, kappa_W, lambda_W, tau_H, tau_W, W0

ordered_gates.description: Search for self-consistent active fixed point with syn*>0
If FP unavailable, periodic-orbit return map P_T and monodromy M with rho(M)<1 (subleading multiplier)

reduced_modes.stability_inequality: a_H * lambda_W * tau_H > 2 * kappa_W * b_HW * tau_W (when b_HW > 0)

margin_policy: Report spectral margins vs I_tonic; margins below 0.01 are near-critical, not robustly stable
w3_kernel_blocked_until: active operating regime passes W3a local stability gate
